rule: No system, module, feature, package, AI tool/agent or operational capability may begin implementation until it is represented here or in a child registry entry that conforms to .ai/schemas/development-unit.schema.json and is mapped to an active plan.

units.name: Runtime Identity & Install Closure
units.summary: Installed-runtime identity, compatibility and readiness convergence.
acceptance_criteria: Real-target compatibility and post-install readiness pass without rewriting immutable identity planes.

units.name: Core Admin Functional QA
units.summary: Auth, users, roles, settings, media and core CRUD live verification.
acceptance_criteria: Core Admin workflows are usable and target-verified.

units.name: AI Governance Automation
units.summary: CI validation for registry, stage graph, active plans, DoD, state and handoff consistency.
acceptance_criteria: CI rejects missing/unplanned/inconsistent AI control-plane state.

units.name: Admin UX & Design System
units.summary: Consistent accessible responsive Admin UI and interaction states.
acceptance_criteria: Admin screens consistently use governed components and accessibility baseline.

units.name: Continuous Security Baseline
units.summary: Early AppSec, identity, browser, tenancy, CI and secure-development baseline.
acceptance_criteria: Critical baseline controls and security CI are enforced before large expansion work.

units.name: Architecture Boundary Enforcement
units.summary: Align implementation with Nexora public contracts, persistence and module boundaries.
acceptance_criteria: Automated architecture tests cover all protected platform domains and deliberate exceptions are documented.

units.name: Theme Engine
units.summary: Theme package validation, install, preview, activation, switch, rollback and rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Theme lifecycle is end-to-end target-verified through Sentinel/trust boundaries.

units.name: Extension Lifecycle
units.summary: Extension/App/Integration/Studio Pack lifecycle, capabilities, dependencies and rollback/uninstall.
acceptance_criteria: All package families execute their current lifecycle safely with capability grants and history.

units.name: Nexora Studio
units.summary: Structured visual editor workflow, dynamic bindings, responsive state, revisions and publish/render.
acceptance_criteria: A real page can be visually edited, previewed and published without arbitrary executable markup shortcuts.

units.name: CMS & Publishing Foundation
units.summary: Documents, Writer, revisions, editorial workflow, blog/articles, authors, taxonomies, series and archives.
acceptance_criteria: Current structured publishing lifecycle is target-verified.

units.name: Media & Distribution Foundation
units.summary: Media library, newsletter, RSS and distribution adapters.
acceptance_criteria: Upload/select/delivery/distribution flows are secure and verified.

units.name: SEO, Search & Crawler Foundation
units.summary: Theme-independent SEO Core, Schema Graph, sitemap, internal links, search, analytics and crawler.
acceptance_criteria: SEO/search/crawler workflows operate on canonical resources with evidence-based audits.

units.name: Automation & Webhooks
units.summary: Triggers, conditions, actions, retries, signed inbound/outbound webhooks and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow/webhook execution is bounded, idempotent, signed and observable.

units.name: Dynamic Content Model 2.0
units.summary: User/code-defined content types, custom fields/groups, relations, hierarchy and policies.
acceptance_criteria: Content schemas support typed fields/relations/hierarchy with permissions, API/search/Studio policies and safe schema evolution.

units.name: Generic Taxonomy 2.0
units.summary: Taxonomy definitions, hierarchy, content bindings and extension registration.
acceptance_criteria: Generic taxonomies work across arbitrary content types and public contracts.

units.name: Typed Query & Archive Engine
units.summary: Typed filters, sort, pagination, relations, taxonomies, saved queries and archives.
acceptance_criteria: Queries are typed, permission-aware, performant and reusable by themes/Studio/API/AI.

units.name: Routing, Permalinks & Redirects 2.0
units.summary: Deterministic route resolver, archives, rewrite patterns, collisions, redirects and canonicals.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical public routing is deterministic and collision/redirect safe.

units.name: Public Navigation & Menus
units.summary: Nested menus, locations, content/taxonomy/custom targets, conditions and public contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Themes/Studio/API/AI can use stable menu locations and typed menu targets.

units.name: Theme Contract 2.0
units.summary: Template hierarchy/parts, manifest 2.0, tokens, menu locations, slots and support flags.
acceptance_criteria: Theme rendering uses deterministic public presentation contracts rather than private Core overrides.

units.name: Extension SDK 2.0
units.summary: Typed events/filters, UI/theme slots, admin pages, runtime APIs and registration surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Third-party/first-party packages can extend supported surfaces without private Core access.

units.name: Visual Site Builder 2.0
units.summary: Visual AST, reusable components, dynamic templates/bindings, responsive layout, interactions and history.
acceptance_criteria: Professional responsive sites/templates can be built visually using structured validated data.

units.name: Theme Studio & Global Design System
units.summary: Global tokens, sections, template parts and theme-level visual design.
acceptance_criteria: Site-wide visual systems can be edited consistently with reusable tokens/components.

units.name: Preview, Staging, Branching & Publishing
units.summary: Draft branches, preview URLs, merge/conflict handling, scheduled/single/multi-page publish, promotion and rollback.
acceptance_criteria: Content/design changes can be safely previewed, reviewed, promoted, published and rolled back.

units.name: Templates, Patterns & Starter Kits
units.summary: Site/page/section/component/theme/commerce kits with dependency-aware install/update/customization.
acceptance_criteria: Users can start quickly from safe reusable starter systems without losing upgrade/customization control.

units.name: Localization & Multilingual 2.0
units.summary: Localized UI/CMS/components/SEO, hreflang and translation workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Localized content/design/SEO can be independently reviewed and published per locale.

units.name: Frontend Delivery Runtime 2.0
units.summary: Caching, CDN, image pipeline, invalidation and rendering budgets.
acceptance_criteria: Public delivery is cache-correct, performant and security-header aware.

units.name: Media DAM 2.0
units.summary: Asset organization, usage graph, transforms, dedupe, metadata/rights and external storage.
acceptance_criteria: Media is searchable, transformable, traceable and safely delivered across sites/content.

units.name: Search 2.0
units.summary: Facets, provider abstraction and advanced indexing/querying.
acceptance_criteria: Search supports facets/providers while canonical data remains authoritative.

units.name: Forms, Leads & Workflow Builder
units.summary: Visual forms, validation, anti-abuse, lead capture and workflow actions.
acceptance_criteria: Forms are secure, accessible and connected to governed workflows/providers.

units.name: Privacy & Consent Platform
units.summary: Consent categories, GPC/DNT, retention, export/delete and regional policy integration.
acceptance_criteria: Data collection and retention honor consent/privacy policies with auditable decisions.

units.name: Nexora AI Kernel
units.summary: Model gateway, agents, Tool Registry, capability gate, context, approvals, audit, evals and telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: AI actions execute only through typed least-privilege tools with identity, policy, audit and evals.

units.name: SEO, AEO & AI Visibility 2.0
units.summary: Expanded SEO resource model, entity/schema intelligence, AI-readable outputs and citation/visibility workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Sites expose semantically consistent search/AI-readable resources and evidence-based optimization workflows.

units.name: Public API Platform
units.summary: REST/GraphQL/OAuth, webhook subscriptions and headless delivery.
acceptance_criteria: Versioned scoped APIs expose public resources without bypassing tenancy/authorization.

units.name: Configuration as Code
units.summary: Validated site/schema/config export, diff and apply.
acceptance_criteria: Config changes are portable, diffable, validated and environment-safe.

units.name: External AI Agent Interoperability
units.summary: Scoped agent gateway, capability negotiation, typed tools and audited read/draft/execute policies.
acceptance_criteria: External agents interoperate without direct database/filesystem/secret/private-Core access.

units.name: AI Content & SEO Assistant
units.summary: Governed CMS/media/SEO/AEO drafting and actions.
acceptance_criteria: AI content actions are schema-valid, permission-aware, auditable and reviewable.

units.name: AI Design Professional
units.summary: Brief-to-IA/content model/navigation/tokens/components/visual AST/responsive/accessibility workflow.
acceptance_criteria: AI-generated designs remain structured, responsive, accessible, reviewable and rollback-safe.

units.name: Design/Figma Import
units.summary: Import design sources into structured tokens/components/layout AST with validation.
acceptance_criteria: Imported designs become validated Nexora structures rather than trusted raw executable markup.

units.name: AI Developer & Package Assistant
units.summary: SDK-aware app/extension/theme scaffolding, review and test/eval support.
acceptance_criteria: AI development follows registered units, public contracts, tests, security review and handoff gates.

units.name: Experimentation Platform
units.summary: A/B and multivariate testing, goals, rollout, analytics and AI-assisted variants.
acceptance_criteria: Experiments are deterministic, privacy-aware, reversible and measured against explicit goals.

units.name: Privacy-Safe Personalization
units.summary: Audience/segment-based content/component targeting with deterministic fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Personalization respects consent/tenancy and never leaks segment/private data.

units.name: Capability-Bounded App Runtime
units.summary: Low-code/full-stack functions, jobs, schedules, data actions, integration calls and secrets through controlled capabilities.
acceptance_criteria: App logic cannot bypass capability, tenant, secret, network or execution boundaries.

units.name: Migration Center
units.summary: WordPress/Webflow/Drupal/Shopify import adapters, loss reports, redirects and idempotent retries.
acceptance_criteria: Imports are dry-runnable, repeatable, loss-transparent and SEO-safe.

units.name: Developer Experience & SDK
units.summary: CLI, SDK, docs, package generators, reference packages and compatibility tooling.
acceptance_criteria: Developers can build/test/package against public Nexora contracts without private knowledge.

units.name: Marketplace & Publisher Economy
units.summary: Current marketplace closure followed by discovery, licensing, compatibility and safe updates.
acceptance_criteria: Publisher packages move through trust, compatibility, install and update channels with revocation/rollback controls.

units.name: Commerce 2.0
units.summary: Catalog, variants, inventory, discounts, cart, checkout, functions, providers and fulfillment.
acceptance_criteria: Commerce mutation/payment/provider flows are secure, idempotent and extensible through controlled surfaces.

units.name: CRM, Membership & Helpdesk Closure
units.summary: Verify existing customer, entitlement and ticket foundations.
acceptance_criteria: Existing business-domain workflows are target-verified without bypassing Identity/Commerce boundaries.

units.name: Customer & Member Portal Builder
units.summary: Authenticated portals across commerce, CRM, membership and helpdesk.
acceptance_criteria: Portal pages expose only authorized tenant/customer/member data with extension-safe account surfaces.

units.name: Collaboration & Approvals
units.summary: Presence, locks, comments, approvals and collaborative publishing workflows.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent collaboration preserves permissions, audit history and conflict safety.

units.name: Nexora Managed Cloud
units.summary: Optional managed provisioning, domains/SSL, CDN, backups, staging/deploy history, monitoring, metering and scaling.
acceptance_criteria: Managed hosting remains operationally isolated, observable, recoverable and compatible with self-hosted architecture.

units.name: Enterprise & Distributed Runtime Closure
units.summary: Organizations/tenancy/SSO/SCIM/governance and HA foundations verification.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprise identity/tenancy/distributed-runtime foundations have real evidence.

units.name: Sentinel 2.0 & Runtime Isolation
units.summary: Vulnerability intelligence, stronger package policy, revocation and isolated executable runtime strategy.
acceptance_criteria: Untrusted executable packages have a real isolation path and compromised packages can be rapidly revoked/contained.

units.name: Enterprise Governance 2.0
units.summary: Policy center, SSO/SCIM closure, audit/impersonation and tenancy hardening.
acceptance_criteria: Enterprise policy and identity governance are auditable and least-privilege across tenants.

units.name: Observability & Operations Center
units.summary: Logs, metrics, traces, jobs, queues, health, AI/package/security evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Operators can detect, diagnose and scope failures/security events without leaking secrets.

units.name: Update, Rollback & Disaster Recovery
units.summary: Atomic updates, rollback, backup/restore, DR rehearsal and evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Updates/recovery are integrity-checked, reversible where designed and proven on disposable targets.

units.name: Books & Manuscripts
units.summary: Books/manuscripts/chapters/editions/EPUB/print as external first-party package.
acceptance_criteria: Package uses public contracts only and installs without private Core shortcuts.

units.name: Professional Profile / CV / Biography
units.summary: Profile/CV/resume/biography/portfolio as external first-party package.
acceptance_criteria: Package uses public contracts and optional profile themes.

units.name: LMS
units.summary: Courses/lessons/quizzes/progress as external App/Extension.
acceptance_criteria: LMS is deliverable entirely through public package/runtime contracts.

units.name: Booking
units.summary: Services/staff/availability/appointments as external App/Extension.
acceptance_criteria: Booking is deliverable entirely through public package/runtime contracts.

units.name: Projects & Tasks
units.summary: Projects/tasks/boards/milestones/time tracking as external App/Extension.
acceptance_criteria: Projects product is deliverable entirely through public package/runtime contracts.
